data.headline: EPA approves final cleanup plan for Texas Superfund site tied to WM subsidiary
data.summary: The final approval comes after years of disagreements between the U.S. EPA, a WM subsidiary and International Paper. Estimated cleanup costs for the San Jacinto River Waste Pits site are $115 million.
